propositions: eval/calibration surface excludes activated project code-review criteria because _code_review_prompt_id and calibrate_criterion lack repository context
When repo_root is provided, _code_review_prompt_id must admit logical criteria returned by code_review.registry.effective_criteria mapped through criterion_prompt_id with gate_key="code_review"
calibrate_criterion must select the code-review arm when repo_root is not None and criterion_id is in effective_criteria, resolving via criterion_prompt_id with gate_key="code_review"
EvalError from load_eval_spec in the code-review arm must be re-raised with located context including the logical criterion_id
Backward compatibility requires _code_review_prompt_id to admit built-in ids without repo_root and plan-review criteria to follow unchanged calibration path even with non-None repo_root
